The generic item's per-character fitted variant SK_CH_dra_hef_skull (Dragunov) is the converted mesh — the same skeleton Slice's Attire 1 binds; all 43 SK variants + MI + 4 textures were extracted (48 .uasset, 8.0MB, UE magic C1 83 2A 9E verified) and are stored in release w6-tekken7-parts-20261021 (skull-mask-uassets.zip, sha256 in the PR).
conversion.tool: umodel_linux (held build 1578, from tekken7-full-v1) -export -gltf + TGAs -> Blender 4.0.2 material bind per the game's own MI_CH_cmn_hef_skull (Diffuse=D, Normal=N, SpecPower=R, Metallic scalar 0.45) -> GLB, stray umodel Icosphere helper removed

conversion.notes: color_slots RESOLVED 2026-10-22 (W6b): CCI_dra_hef_skull + CI_dra_hef_skull extracted piecewise from the same TR205 archive (folder 0) and parsed directly (umodel loads the packages but cannot dump these classes) — color_slots = 4 from CCI ItemColors[0].InstanceColors/ColorIndicies (defaults + palette mapping in customization_records; full parse in records-dra.json; all 39 characters' CCI color records are identical). Placement offsets are 0 because the DRA-fitted mesh is already at head position in Dragunov skeleton space (measured bbox z 1.706..2.037, x/y centered on 0).

customization_records.raw_uassets_release: w6-tekken7-parts-20261021: skull-mask-records-dra.zip (CI+CCI for DRA) and skull-mask-records-all-chars.zip (80 records, 39 characters + DRA suit pair)
customization_records.color_slots_source: CCI.ItemColors[0].InstanceColors (4 FLinearColor) + CCI.ItemColors[0].ColorIndicies (4) + CCI.Index0Colors (4) — this item's colorable material channels; CCI.IndexColors (5) is the shared palette (system max 5 per tekken7-slot-catalog.json), not the item channel count
